status: proposed by M1; not frozen until validation/test listening verification and M6 review
description: Turkish Grand National Assembly (TBMM) plenary speech about the economy, public finance, tax, wages/pensions, banking, trade and legislation, selected from WorldSpeech tr_tr with a versioned domain lexicon and split by recording.

rights.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (WorldSpeech); source terms: TBMM parliamentary proceedings, https://www.tbmm.gov.tr/
rights.attribution: WorldSpeech (disco-eth) and the Grand National Assembly of Turkey (TBMM)
rights.sharing: audio, reference text and the exclusion ledger stay outside the public Git repository; only opaque IDs, hashes, counts and source URLs are committed

configuration.erratum: Fixed 2026-11-18: the release config said 'soxr VHQ' while the audio was always written with soxr 'HQ' (src/turkish_asr_rdl/data/release.py); the config now says HQ.

audio.conversion: decode OGG Opus 24 kHz stereo, float32 channel mean, soxr HQ resample to 16 kHz
audio.rebuild_note: Rebuilt locally 2026-11-18; split files and exclusion ledger byte-identical to the first build; FLAC bytes differ by at most 1 LSB per sample (library rounding).

references.origin: upstream_human (TBMM stenographic minutes as aligned by WorldSpeech)

verification_status.train: unreviewed (labelled as such in training runs)
verification_status.validation: unreviewed; listening verification required before freeze
verification_status.test: unreviewed; listening verification required before freeze

speakers: unknown for every row; speaker-disjointness is not claimed
limitations: References are edited minutes, not verbatim transcripts, until listening review.
The upstream CER <= 0.25 alignment filter favours segments an upstream ASR system handled well.
Topic labels and relational facts are automatic lexicon matches (lexicon-screening-unverified).
Pre-2026 audio and minutes are public, so pretraining contamination of baselines cannot be excluded for train/validation; test uses only 2026 sessions.
